name: selection-tint
description: Tints the app in one of eight colors, in light and dark mode, so the selected sidebar row is no longer gray. Pick colors with /tint.

color.title: Tint color
color.description: The color for the app background and the selected sidebar row, in light and dark mode.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: System follows the app's own light/dark setting. Light or Dark pins the app to that mode.
